skills.name: Fated Death
skills.description:
Passive: At the start of battle, marks the mirrored enemy unit with the [Fated Death] status. ([Fated Death]: Takes an additional 5% True DMG when receiving damage.)
Active: Deals 700% ATK DMG to the nearest enemy, reduces the target's Max HP by 100% of ATK, and deals additional DMG equal to 10% of the target's missing HP. Prioritizes targets in the [Fated Death] status.

upgrades.level3: Additional DMG equal to missing HP increases to 15%.

skills.name: Weaving Fate
skills.description: Enters the 'Weaving' state, increasing subsequent charge DMG by 100% ATK every second. When the HP of the unit with [Fated Death] drops to 50% or 'Weaving' lasts for 12s, charges toward the unit with [Fated Death], dealing 300% ATK DMG.

upgrades.level2: In the 'Weaving' state, subsequent charge DMG increases by 130% ATK every second.
upgrades.level4: In the 'Weaving' state, subsequent charge DMG increases by 160% ATK every second.

skills.name: Unseen Fate
skills.description: If Ananke takes no DMG for 5s, she enters an untargetable state, which is canceled after she attacks.

upgrades.level2: Enters untargetable state after taking no DMG for 4s.
upgrades.level3: Enters untargetable state after taking no DMG for 3s.
upgrades.level4: Immediately enters this state upon assisting in or securing a kill.

skills.name: Threads of Fate
skills.description: Deals 300% ATK DMG to enemies within a 3-meter radius. DMG dealt to targets with [Fated Death] is additionally increased by 200% ATK.

upgrades.level2: DMG dealt to targets with [Fated Death] is additionally increased by 300% ATK.
upgrades.level3: Increases DMG dealt to enemies within a 3-meter radius to 400% ATK.
upgrades.level4: DMG dealt to targets with [Fated Death] is additionally increased by 400% ATK.

relic.name: Absolute Necessity
relic.description: Targets with [Fated Death] take an additional 10% True DMG when receiving damage.

upgrades.level2: After the unit with [Fated Death] dies, immediately re-marks the enemy unit with the highest ATK with [Fated Death].
upgrades.level3: Targets with [Fated Death] take an additional 20% True DMG when receiving damage.
upgrades.level4: After Ananke assists in or secures a kill on an enemy with [Fated Death], she immediately triggers a charge of [Weaving Fate] against the next enemy with [Fated Death].
